files.types/index.d.ts:
export type Post = {
  id: string
  text: string
  createdAt: string
  username: string
  name: string
  likes?: number
  reposts?: number
  replies?: number
  isReply?: boolean
  repostedBy?: string
  replyingTo?: string[]
  links?: Record<string, { display: string; href: string }>
  media?: number
  isQuote?: boolean
  targetId?: string
  conversationId?: string
  images?: Array<{ key: string; url: string; alt: string; kind: 'photo' | 'video'; width: number; height: number }>
  hasNoCounts?: boolean
  quote?: { id: string; name: string; username: string; text: string; isVerified?: boolean; links?: Record<string, { display: string; href: string }> }
  views?: number
  isVerified?: boolean
}

export type AuthStatus = 'unknown' | 'signed-out' | 'waiting' | 'signed-in'

export type Mode = 'home' | 'mentions' | 'tags' | 'bookmarks' | 'view'

export type PerMode<T> = { home: T; mentions: T; tags: T; bookmarks: T; view: T }

export type ListInfo = { id: string; name: string; members: number | null; isPrivate: boolean; description: string }

export type TrendInfo = { name: string; posts: number | null; category: string | null }

export type Profile = {
  id: string
  name: string
  username: string
  description: string
  location: string | null
  url: string | null
  followers: number
  following: number
  posts: number
  joined: string | null
  isVerified: boolean
}

// What the fourth list holds: one post's thread, or one person's posts.
export type View =
  | { kind: 'thread'; rootId: string; username: string }
  | { kind: 'user'; profile: Profile }
  | { kind: 'search'; query: string }
  | { kind: 'list'; listId: string; name: string }
  | { kind: 'likes'; username: string; userId: string }
  | { kind: 'lists'; lists: ListInfo[] }
  | { kind: 'trends'; trends: TrendInfo[] }

export type Status = {
  auth: AuthStatus
  mode: Mode
  isLoading: boolean
  error: string | null
  notice: string | null
  fetchedAt: PerMode<number | null>
  account: string | null
  authorizeUrl: string | null
  autoMinutes: number
  canPost: boolean
  canLike: boolean
  newIds: string[]
  unread: PerMode<number>
  liked: string[]
  reposted: string[]
  bookmarked: string[]
  followed: string[]
  muted: string[]
  deleteAsk: string | null
  repostAsk: string | null
  shown: PerMode<string[]>
  view: View | null
  cursor: number
  liveTail: string | null
  chatLimit: number
  imagesReady: string[]
  backTo: Mode
  hasMore: PerMode<boolean>
  tags: string[]
  activeTag: string | null
  qrFor: string | null
}

export type Draft = {
  text: string
  replyTo: { id: string; username: string } | null
  quoteOf: { id: string; username: string; name: string; text: string } | null
  images: string[]
  isConfirming: boolean
  isPosting: boolean
}

declare module 'claude-code' {
  interface PluginState {
    'x-timeline': { posts: Post[]; mentions: Post[]; tagPosts: Post[]; bookmarkPosts: Post[]; viewPosts: Post[]; status: Status; draft: Draft }
  }
}
